tree.heading: Intervention
tree.text: The Oversight Board may intervene in any litigation filed against the territorial government.

children.heading: In general
children.text: If the Oversight Board intervenes in a litigation under subsection (a), the Oversight Board may seek injunctive relief, including a stay of litigation.

children.heading: No independent basis for relief
children.text: This section does not create an independent basis on which injunctive relief, including a stay of litigation, may be granted.
